newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian stocks end firmer after late rally.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian stocks end firmer after late rally.

text.p: *Stocks ended firmer after a late rally lifted the market off its lows. Volume 305.0 million shares, value A$644.0 million, 1,034 stocks traded, 315 steady, 392 up, 327 down
Australian shares closed firmer on Thursday, a late buying spree sprucing up an otherwise lifeless session as investors contemplated the future direction of local interest rates.
The benchmark All Ordinaries index closed 13.5 points higher at 2,350.2, well off its intra-session low of 2,329.3.
The December share price index ended seven points firmer at 2,360, a 9.8 point premium to the underlying index.
Brokers said low turnover indicated that investors remained squarely non-commital ahead of next week's Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) board meeting and the imminent U.S. elections.

Westpac was the outstanding performer, its shares closing 17 cents higher at A$7.20 on turnover of 3.15 million shares. Outside of the bank sector, the market was relatively subdued. Chemical manufacturer ICI Australia provided some minor interest, slipping 20 cents to A$12.40 after Wednesday's 26.7 percent lower full year profit of A$197.1 million.
In other local markets, Australian bonds clawed back most of their early losses during the course of session after initial weakness in the short end lacked follow through.
The yield on 10 year T-bonds closed at 7.40 percent, unchanged from Wednesday's levels.
